commands.name: List Running Processes (pslist)
commands.desc: Enumerates active Windows processes via the EPROCESS double-linked list.

commands.name: Scan for Unlinked/Hidden Processes (pstree)
commands.desc: Renders process relationships in a tree hierarchy to spot unlinked or parentless binaries.

commands.name: Detect Code Injections (malfind)
commands.desc: Finds memory pages marked PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (PAGE_NOCACHE/VAD allocation).

commands.name: Dump Process Memory by PID
commands.desc: Extracts executable binaries and DLL memory blocks for static YARA or string analysis.

commands.name: Active Sockets with PID Correlation
commands.desc: Correlates active inbound/outbound sockets to owning process IDs.

commands.name: Inspect Active Scheduled Tasks for Persistence
commands.cmd: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.State -ne 'Disabled'} | Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State
commands.desc: Scans active scheduled tasks configured for persistent execution.

commands.name: Find Unsigned Executables in Temp Folders
commands.desc: Identifies unverified binaries or payload drops in user and system temp directories.

commands.name: Base64 & Deobfuscate PowerShell Payload
commands.desc: Decodes standard base64 encoded PowerShell command lines (`-EncodedCommand`).

commands.name: XOR Brute Force Payload Decryption
commands.desc: Brute-forces single-byte XOR keys against obfuscated shellcode strings.

commands.name: Defang URLs / IP Addresses
commands.desc: Converts active IOC links into safe forms (e.g., `hxxp://` and `192[.]168[.]1[.]1`) for reporting.
